drawings.description: en marge, un croquis : une bande allongée, $A$ à gauche, deux traits transverses $C$ et $D$, $B$ à droite
drawings.notes: A long strip, its left end a thick stroke A, two transverse thick strokes C and D, open at the right end B. The long diagonal line crossing the sketch is one of the strokes striking the page and is not drawn.

drawings.description: croquis à gauche du texte : un rectangle hachuré, ses deux côtés verticaux épaissis et marqués $A \simeq B^1$ et $B \simeq B^1$, traversé d'une courbe marquée $C \simeq D^1$ ; au-dessous, « ou », un fuseau hachuré entre deux points $A$ et $B$, traversé de même. $D^1$ est écrit ainsi, là où l'on attend $B^1$
drawings.kind: hatched rectangle and hatched spindle, crossed by a curve
drawings.notes: Above: a hatched rectangle, its vertical sides thickened and labelled A = B^1 and B = B^1, crossed by a curve labelled C = D^1; below, a hatched spindle between the points A and B, crossed likewise. The "ou" between them is not located on the crop and left out.

drawings.description: croquis : un cercle portant deux points marqués $a$ et $b$, et coupé en haut et en bas par deux petits traits marqués chacun $c$ — le lieu est ici une sphère $S^0$, deux points
drawings.kind: circle with two marked points cut by two strokes
drawings.notes: A circle carrying the ringed points a and b, cut at the top and the bottom by two short strokes each labelled c.

drawings.description: croquis à gauche : une couronne entre deux cercles, coupée en haut par un trait épais marqué $A$, les deux bords du trait marqués $\rho$ et $\rho'$, et en bas par un second trait ; les deux moitiés de la couronne sont marquées $U$ et $V$
drawings.notes: An annulus between two circles, cut at the top by a thick stroke A whose two sides are labelled rho and rho', and at the bottom by a second stroke; the halves are labelled U (left) and V (right).

drawings.description: au-dessus de la ligne, au-dessus de « $\dot{W}_t$ » et de la glose : un petit croquis, un trait vertical à gauche d'où partent vers la droite deux traits presque horizontaux qui se rejoignent en pointe — un fuseau très effilé —, hachuré dans son tiers droit ; deux petits traits verticaux le surmontent, dont le second le traverse ; un trait oblique descend de sa pointe vers la glose « cl $\smallsetminus$ i ».
drawings.kind: thin hatched wedge above the line (tubular neighbourhood?)
drawings.notes: Above the line, over the dotted W_t and the gloss: a vertical stroke on the left with a short foot to the right; from it a thick, nearly horizontal line and, under it, a second line which rises to meet the first at one computed point (a very thin wedge); a zigzag hatching in the right third of the wedge; two short vertical strokes above, the second crossing the upper line; an oblique stroke from the upper line down to the gloss. The gloss itself (read « cl \ i » in the transcription) and the words of the line are text and are not drawn. Partial: the hatching is schematic, and it is not certain that this is a sketch (the tubular neighbourhood W_t, its hatched part) and not a struck word: the vertical with its foot could be a letter L and the two long lines a double strike. The transcription's note only says « petit croquis »; the description of the new mark follows the page. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sous la note marginale, un petit ovale portant deux gros points, l'un en haut à droite, l'autre en bas à gauche — $S^1$ et deux points.
drawings.notes: A small oval, slightly tilted, with two heavy points placed on it (computed on the curve), one at the upper right, one at the lower left: the example « S^1 et deux pts » of the marginal note above it. Left out: the words of the oblique note, the stroke that frames it, and a faint long oblique line to the right. The upper left of the oval is gone over twice on the page; drawn once. Redrawn 2026-11-10 (issue 128): to check again.
